prompt:
CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE: ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, words, numbers, runes, hieroglyphs, symbols, UI text, watermarks, logos. Use ONLY abstract fracture patterns for decorative markings.

CRITICAL: NO HALO RINGS. No circular discs behind head. No glowing rings.
CRITICAL: NO ANIMALS AT FEET. No companion animals, no creatures. Energy/void patterns only.
CRITICAL: THE HOLLOW IS NOT A PLAYABLE DEITY. This creature must look INCOMPLETE, FRACTURED, CORRUPTED. Where deities radiate divine light, this creature ABSORBS light. Where deities are alive, this creature is ABSENCE. Where deities have faces, this creature has broken or missing masks.
CRITICAL: HOLLOW AESTHETIC — charcoal-black void-stuff body (pure absence given form, NOT metal, NOT stone, NOT flesh). White fracture cracks (cold white lines where light dies, NOT warm energy, NOT fire). Incomplete or broken masks. Broken Gate stone embedded in body (fragments of the original Mythos Gates fused into the form). Negative-space wounds (holes showing ACTIVE NOTHING, the void that consumes). Anti-light seams (absolute black that drinks surrounding light). Ash falling UPWARD (gravity inverts around Hollow creatures).
CRITICAL: NOT EVIL, NOT DEMONIC — the Hollow is EROSION, not malice. It is absence, not corruption with intent. It should feel like looking at a wound in reality, not at a villain. Cold, silent, erasing, not raging or screaming.
CRITICAL: EPIC SCALE — this creature is large but SMALLER than deities. Deities are colossal (hundreds of feet tall). This creature is human-scale to slightly larger (8-15 feet tall). Low camera angle looking up. Show the creature emerging from a Gate fracture or void breach in the ground.
CRITICAL: Readable tactical RPG silhouette — the creature must be readable as a RANGED unit at a glance. Clear weapon or threat indicator. Distinct silhouette from all other Hollow creatures.

Create Hollow Knell Archer, for Mythos Gates: Ascension. The Hollow threat faction.
Faction: The Hollow (non-playable threat faction).
Threat Tier: Minor.
Creature Category: Hollow Creature.
Combat Role: RANGED.
Canon: The Hollow is the anti-civilization that grows in the wound between Realms. It is what the Mythos Gates were built to keep sealed. When the Gates broke, the Hollow came through. This creature carries fragments of broken Gate stone in its body — not as armor, but as the scar of its own creation. Where deities are alive, this creature is absence. Where deities radiate, this creature absorbs.

ART STYLE: Premium dark mythological tactical RPG enemy concept art. Grim dark aesthetic. The Hollow should feel WRONG — like looking at something that should not exist. Not scary in a monster way, but unsettling in an existential way. This is not a demon or a beast — it is a WOUND IN REALITY wearing a shape it stole from something that was real. Painterly textures, deep shadows, void-black depths.

HOLLOW KNELL ARCHER — A tall charcoal archer that fires arrows of anti-light.

BODY: Tall, thin humanoid — 10-12 feet. Charcoal-black void-stuff body, elongated, stretched upward like a figure pulled from both ends. The body is more defined than a Wretch — closer to a complete humanoid silhouette, but still WRONG. The proportions are off — arms too long, torso too narrow, legs too thin. Edges fading to void-fog at the extremities.

MASK: A single horizontal mask-slit where eyes should be — like a visor cut into the void-stuff face. Behind the slit: cold white anti-light, no eyes, just the glow of absence. No mouth. No other features. The mask slit is the only definition on the face.

WEAPON: A broken crescent bow — NOT a normal bow. The bow is made from a curved fragment of broken Gate stone — dark grey arch-stone bent into a bow shape, cracked and incomplete. The bowstring is a line of cold white anti-light. The arrows are pale shards of void-stuff that leave trails of falling upward-ash when fired. The bow should look like it was carved from a piece of the Mythos Gate itself.

CLOTHING: Ragged funeral cloth — torn grey-black fabric hanging from the shoulders and waist. The cloth is covered in erased sigils — patterns that are visibly FADING, like text being scrubbed away in real-time. The cloth should look like it was taken from a funeral and then partially erased.

GATE STONE: A larger fragment embedded in the bow-arm — dark grey arch stone fused into the forearm, as if the arm grew around it. Cold white anti-light seeping from the seam.

POSE: Drawing the bow, arrow nocked, aiming toward the viewer. Standing tall and still — not crouched like a hunter, but upright like an executioner. The pose should feel like a funeral rite, not an attack. Cold, precise, inevitable.

SCALE: 10-12 feet. Camera at medium-low angle. The Archer towers over the viewer. Broken rubble at its feet.

GROUND: The ground around the Archer is streaked with pale arrow-spark residue — white marks where arrows have been fired, leaving traces of anti-light. Ash falling upward. Void-fog drifting low.

BACKGROUND: Dark void environment. Distant broken Gate-arches. Cold, mournful atmosphere — like a funeral held in a void. Palette: charcoal-black, dark grey, cold white, pale anti-light blue-white.

VFX: Pale arrow-sparks drifting from the bowstring. Cold white anti-light from the mask slit. Ash falling upward. Anti-light absorption around the body — light bends toward the Archer and does not return.

SILHOUETTE: Tall, thin, upright with bow. Reads as a ranged unit — the bow is the primary silhouette identifier. Distinct from the Wretch (thinner, taller, armed) and the Choirling (taller, armed, standing upright).
